scripts.postinstall: if [[ -z "$CI" || -n "$FIREBASE_TOOLS" ]]; then bun install --global firebase-tools@13.34.0; fi && bun install --cwd back && bun install --cwd front
scripts.dev: firebase emulators:exec --import .emulators --ui --only functions,firestore 'curl GET http://127.0.0.1:5001/price-it-85b3e/europe-west3/system-migration && bun --cwd back tsc --watch & bun --cwd front dev'

scripts.graphql:gen: bun --cwd back graphql:gen && bun --cwd front nuxt prepare
